comment: The examples do not adequately demonstrate the most consequential platform pattern for LMICs: a national DHIS2-based RHIS growing incrementally into shared infrastructure across programmes and capabilities. Technology lists miss the common organisational hierarchy and metadata, aggregate/Tracker coexistence, cross-programme analytics, offline operation, local HISP support, long-term upgrades and governance that make the platform infrastructural.

reviewer.name: Brian O'Donnell (on behalf of HISP-UiO)

public.text: The examples do not adequately demonstrate the most consequential platform pattern for LMICs: a national DHIS2-based RHIS growing incrementally into shared infrastructure across programmes and capabilities. Technology lists miss the common organisational hierarchy and metadata, aggregate/Tracker coexistence, cross-programme analytics, offline operation, local HISP support, long-term upgrades and governance that make the platform infrastructural.
public.suggestedRevision: Add one or more structured DHIS2 country trajectories using a common evidence template: installed base; shared metadata/organisational units; programmes and capabilities co-realised; aggregate/event/Tracker flows; APIs/interoperability; decentralised use; offline reach; HISP/local capacity; governance/financing; scale and duration; measured outcomes; safeguards and limitations. Uganda can be one case, with another mature national RHIS example.
